ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-level ratio with approximately 80% low-intensity (black) pixels and 20% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in discrete circular clusters across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches located at the distal tips of both left and right lobes; high-density distribution of small, circular white blobs (rosettes) throughout the central and lower dark-pigmented regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; pixel-amplitude variations of peaks and valleys range from 3 to 15 pixels across the entire linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the leading edges with a sharp upward curve at the distal tips; trailing edges follow a concave sweep from the median notch outward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-30 pixels in diameter) distributed across the entire visible dark ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, white unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe, intersecting the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) throughout the surface; visible biofouling or material accumulation at the extreme distal tips appearing as irregular brownish-white clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-frequency speckled texture created by the dense distribution of white circular scars against the dark-pigmented ventral surface.
